title: SDK compatibility bump and migration kits for streaming, structured output, and function-calling
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Summary: Prepare the SDK surface and sample kits to support a backwards-compatible minor version bump that enables improved streaming framing, a standardized structured-output wrapper, and normalized function-calling parameter semantics. Deliver artifacts: migration guides, language-specific sample kits (Python/JS/Go), release notes copy, telemetry dashboards to track migration, and a staged canary rollout plan.

Context: Runtime team will ship small protocol changes in runtime-1.19 that improve latency and reduce duplicate tokens in streaming. To unlock these improvements customers must adopt SDKs that understand the new streaming chunk framing and the new structured-output envelope. We need to coordinate cross-functional docs, samples, release notes, and a telemetry-driven rollout to minimize customer impact.
acceptance_criteria:
- Language SDKs (py/js/go) publish compatible minor releases: patch clients accept both legacy and new frames without breaking.
- Migration guide with step-by-step code diffs and quickstart sample for each language.
- Release notes draft reviewed by Eng, DX, and Legal.
- Samples repository updated with at least 6 end-to-end examples (chat-streaming, function-calling with schema, embeddings + rerank).
- Telemetry dashboard (Grafana) showing adoption rate, errors by client-version, streaming latency percentiles; alerts wired.
- Canary rollout executed: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with documented rollback thresholds.
- Customer-facing deprecation timeline published if any legacy behavior is removed in a future major release.
checklist: Confirm protocol change contract with runtime (ENG-28411)
Finalize compatibility strategy: graceful parsing + opt-in header for strict mode
Implement parsing fallback in Python SDK (PR #8321)
Implement parsing fallback in JS SDK (PR #8354)
Implement parsing fallback in Go SDK (PR #8379)
Author migration guide: code diffs + FAQ
Update SDK samples repo: add streaming structured-output example and function-calling with schema enforcement
Draft release notes and localized snippets
Build telemetry dashboard and alerts: adoption, error-rate, latency regressions
Run internal pilot with two customers and Solutions Eng
Execute canary rollout and record lessons learned
Post-launch follow-up: triage issues, patch backlog, update docs
release_notes_snippet: sdk-2026.03: Minor compatibility update — improves streaming efficiency and standardizes structured output. To benefit from lower latency and fewer duplicate tokens in streaming responses, upgrade to SDK clients >= 1.3.x. See migration guide for automated fallbacks and examples across Python, JS, and Go.
rollout_plan:
Phase 0 (Internal): Merge SDK PRs, verify CI, smoke tests across supported runtimes. Phase 1 (Canary 5%): Route 5% of non-critical traffic for 72 hours; monitor errors_by_client_version and streaming_token_dup_rate. Phase 2 (Ramp 25%): If metrics within thresholds, increase to 25% for 48 hours. Phase 3 (Full): Ramp to 100% with continued monitoring for 7 days.
Rollback thresholds: error rate delta > 0.5% absolute vs baseline OR 95th-percentile streaming latency increase > 40% OR customer-reported functional regressions.
Communication: pre-rollout note to customers with SDKs used, in-product banner for affected orgs, and a dedicated support slack channel during Canary.
telemetry_metrics_and_alerts:
- streaming_token_dup_rate by client_version
- streaming_latency_p95/p99 by client_version
- sdk_client_error_rate by version
- migration_adoption_pct (requests using SDK version >= 1.3.x)
Alerts wired to #sdk-rollout with playbook entries for threshold crossings.

risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Customers using pinned older SDKs may not pick up minor release quickly and could miss structured-output semantics. Mitigation: SDKs implement transparent fallback parsing; product will surface in-app guidance and an opt-in header to force strict mode.
Risk: Function-calling schema strictness could break integrators. Mitigation: Provide schema normalization helpers in samples and a linting step in CI for schema conformance.
Risk: Telemetry blind spots for on-prem/private deployments. Mitigation: Include a cli-based adoption ping helper in migration kit and coordinate with Private deployment leads to run the pilot.
followups: Schedule retrospective with Runtime/DevEx/Support (target: within 7 days post-full-rollout)
Create knowledge base article for customers who cannot upgrade SDK immediately
Add migration adoption metric to executive weekly digest
Plan for deprecation timeline if strict mode becomes default in a future major release
